description: İstanbul Çevresinde Gerçekleşen Depremler is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by İtfaiye Dairesi Başkanlığı. 02.2020 tarihine kadar İstanbul çevresinde gerçekleşen depremlerin verisini içerir. Güncel veriye Sismik Portal aracılığı ile ulaşılabilir. Coverage: İtfaiye Dairesi Başkanlığı. The publisher named on the listing is İtfaiye Dairesi Başkanlığı. Its keywords include AKOM, boylam, deprem, enlem, güvenlik, şiddet. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2024-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
